Name: Security Management
Description: Allows the user to manage security settings.

Name: `Transaction Creation
Description: Allows the user to create inventory transaction.

Name: `Transaction Approve
Description: Allows the user to approve inventory transactions.

Name: `Transaction Reject
Description: Allows the user to reject inventory transactions.

Name: Category management
Description: Allows the user to manage catalog categories.

Name: Product Creation
Description: Allows the user to create products for the Catalog.

Name: Goods delivery
Description: Allows the user to hand the goods of a paid sale over to the customer at the warehouse.

Name: Sales note creation
Description: Allows the user to create sales notes (nota de venta).

Name: Sales note reading
Description: Allows the user to see their own sales notes.

Name: Sales note cancellation
Description: Allows the user to cancel their own unpaid sales notes.

Name: Sales note administration
Description: Allows the user to see and cancel the sales notes of every advisor.

Name: Payment reading
Description: Allows the user to see the cashier queue, charge orders and invoices.

Name: Payment collection
Description: Allows the cashier to collect a charge order and issue the invoice.
